title: Development and Implementation of a Port of Los Angeles Digital Twin
tendering_authority: City of Los Angeles Harbor Department
scope_summary: This Request for Proposals (RFP) invites proposals for digital twin services to create a dynamic, data-driven virtual representation of the Port's physical assets, processes, and systems. The project will incrementally connect systems, data, and workflows into a unified spatial environment, focusing on ten key capabilities to deliver measurable results and establish a scalable foundation for future expansion.
